description: Boeing 727-200 built 1979 for Hapag-Lloyd; subsequently Ethiopian Airlines and operators in Colombia; Spain and South Africa; then Allegro Air (Mexico) from 1999. Stored at San José after Allegro ceased operations in 2003 and moved to the hotel site near Dominical in 2010. Fuselage divided into two guest suites — "Toucan" in the nose section and "Colibrí" — with a terrace linking it to the on-site Ricar2 restaurant and pool. A guest review dated January 2026 confirms the Toucan/nose suite still in use; so the airframe is in place and current.
